# Achievements (R-ACH-1 to R-ACH-3): # Defined here rather than in the app so new ones arrive with a database update
# (R-DB-6). `rule` must be one the app knows how to evaluate; an app that meets a rule
# it does not recognise hides that achievement rather than guessing
# rule kind needs an app release but adding a new threshold does not.
# Rules and what `threshold` / `parameter` mean for each:
#   distance              threshold = kilometres travelled in total
#   modes                 threshold = how many different modes of travel
#   collection-complete   parameter = collection id; every member visited
#   collection-count      parameter = collection id; threshold = members visited
#   unesco-in-one-trip    threshold = UNESCO-listed landmarks within a single trip
#   overnight-train       threshold = rail legs that were sleepers or ran overnight
#   crossed-equator       a visit or leg endpoint on each side of the Equator
#   arctic-circle         a visit or leg endpoint north of the Arctic Circle
#   antarctic-circle      a visit or leg endpoint south of the Antarctic Circle
#   antipodes             threshold = kilometres; two visited places at most this far
#                         from being exactly opposite each other on the globe
#                         passing through a pass is crossing it
